fusions.name: Linked Pair
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Reeling Harpoon
fusions.desc: Looses a tethered arrow at a target up to 6 tiles away and reels you to it; it deals 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Binding Net
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second cast, holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shackled Quarry
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
